name: Severe Autosomal Recessive Macrothrombocytopenia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Severe Autosomal Recessive Macrothrombocytopenia

criteria.description: Presence of markedly enlarged platelets with reduced platelet count (macrothrombocytopenia) on peripheral blood smear
Clinically significant mucocutaneous bleeding manifestations including epistaxis, petechiae, and easy bruising
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the causative gene(s) by molecular genetic testing
Normal coagulation screening tests (PT, aPTT) excluding coagulation factor deficiencies
Exclusion of immune thrombocytopenic purpura and other acquired causes of thrombocytopenia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of macrothrombocytopenia with clinically significant bleeding and confirmation of biallelic pathogenic variants in the causative gene(s).
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of clinical, hematological, and genetic findings.

pathognomonic.notes: Enlarged platelets with reduced platelet count on blood smear
Includes epistaxis, petechiae, and easy bruising
searchTerms: severe bleeding from skin and mucous membranes
heavy bleeding in mouth and skin
bleeding lasts long after small cuts

common.notes: Bruises with minimal or no trauma

occasional.notes: Bleeding gums especially after dental procedures
Heavy menstrual bleeding in affected females

searchTerms: tiredness due to low blood count

occasional.notes: Mild to moderate enlargement of the spleen

rare.notes: Occult or overt bleeding in GI tract

laboratory: Presence of giant platelets on peripheral blood smear
Normal bone marrow megakaryocyte number and morphology
imaging: Splenomegaly detected by abdominal ultrasound in some cases

distinguishingFeatures: Defective platelet adhesion due to GPIb-IX-V complex deficiency
Absent or reduced ristocetin-induced platelet aggregation
Presence of Döhle-like inclusion bodies in neutrophils

redFlags: Severe mucocutaneous bleeding disproportionate to platelet count
Intracranial hemorrhage or other life-threatening bleeding
Failure to respond to standard immune thrombocytopenia treatments
